about: Ground plan for the north-pool area (docs/SMOOTH_PATHS.md, drawn by src/ground-plan.ts, checked by scripts/check_ground_plan.py). World metres: x east, z south.
trust: The crazy-paving path is the photo-traced band from data/north_pool_gardens.json (IMG_2204-2206, 2208), now a smooth centreline. The lawn is bounded by that path, Calle Isabel and the dark hedge line the aerial shows on the south; the deck is cut out of it. Edges good to about a metre.

surfaces.name: North pool lawn
surfaces.note: IMG_2204 and IMG_2205 (upper-floor views over the courtyard) show lawn all round the pool deck, from the crazy-paving path on the north and west to the hedges on the south and the paved lane on the east. Its north and west sides are the path's pool-side edge, its east side Calle Isabel's lawn-side edge, its south side the dark hedge line traced from the aerial (scripts/trace_ground.py lawn; the aerial reads the shaded, worn north lawn as not green, so only the south edge is traced). The measured deck is cut out. Good to about a metre.

surfaces.name: North pool · crazy-paving lawn-edge path
surfaces.note: Photo-supported: irregular pale stone paving follows the curved retaining frontage at the northwest and the lower plinths across the north side, flush with the lawn (IMG_2204-2206, 2208). Estimated: 0.96 m width and exact plan curve (about +-2 m registration). Moved 2026-11-14 from data/north_pool_gardens.json as the centreline of its traced band. IMG_2204 shows the paving continuing down the west side along the curved white wall and along the south side behind the hedges; those continuations are not traced yet (task ground-plan-north-pool).
